headline: President Clinton changed an earlier order that set up the National Bioethics Advisory Commission.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12975, which created the National Bioethics Advisory Commission. That commission advised the federal government on ethical questions in research and science involving people. The title does not say exactly what was changed. Changes like this often adjust a commission's end date, membership, or duties, but the source material here does not confirm which.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the National Bioethics Advisory Commission
who_it_affects.how: The rules for the commission they serve on were changed in some way the title does not spell out.

when_it_takes_effect: 1999-09-15 (date signed; effective date not stated in the source)
